io.state: Waiting for source to send event

sql.state: Replica has read all relay log; waiting for more updates

lag_notes: Seconds_Behind_Source is 0 because the applier has caught up with what the receiver has, which is also true when the receiver is far behind the source.

notes: Seconds_Behind_Source compares the original timestamp of the event being applied with the replica's clock, adjusted by the clock difference measured when the receiver connected. A clock change on either server after that skews it, and one long transaction shows as a jump, so it is never the only lag signal.
